DUNADRON

About us

We supply professional-grade FPV and thermal imaging technology to drone manufacturers, system integrators and distributors.

DUNADRON was founded to make advanced drone vision technology easier to integrate, document and support. We select high-performance HD digital video links, low-light cameras and thermal sensors, document them thoroughly and deliver them with the engineering support manufacturers expect.

We work with drone OEMs, system integrators, emergency-service programmes and distributors across Europe and beyond. Sales are currently to businesses; consumer retail is not offered at this stage.
